description: This bar chart, from the paper “Adapting General-Purpose Embedding Models to Private Datasets Using Keyword-based Retrieval,” illustrates the Mean Average Precision at 10 (MAP@10) performance metric for two different sampling strategies—“Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy” (purple bars) and “Uniform Sampling Strategy” (yellow bars)—across five different values of the parameter ‘m’ (6, 7, 8, 9, 10), which is plotted on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “MAP@10,” ranges from 23.0 to 27.0 on a linear scale, with tick marks spaced at 0.5 units. The chart is divided into two distinct groups of bars: the left group corresponds to the Fine-to-Coarse strategy, and the right group corresponds to the Uniform strategy, with each group containing five bars corresponding to the values of m from 6 to 10. For the Fine-to-Coarse strategy, the bars are all purple and show consistently high MAP@10 scores, with values approximately 26.0 (at m=6), 26.9 (at m=7), 26.4 (at m=8), 26.8 (at m=9), and 26.7 (at m=10). For the Uniform strategy, the bars are all yellow and show lower MAP@10 scores, with values approximately 24.4 (at m=6), 24.8 (at m=7), 25.6 (at m=8), 25.2 (at m=9), and 24.4 (at m=10). The bars are not sorted by height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with special formatting such as shading or outlines.
